planets.name: WASP-21 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Tangra with a 4.32-day year, found in 2010.

text.card: WASP-21 b was found in 2010 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Tangra. Its orbit and size follow Bouchy et al. 2010's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname BOUCHY_ET_AL__2010): disc_year 2010, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 4.32250416, pl_radj 1.07, pl_bmassj 0.3

quotes.title: WASP-21
quotes.card: Kinematically, WASP-21 belongs to the thick disk of the Milky Way.
quotes.introduction: It has an exoplanet named WASP-21b.
